learning_objective: 🎯 We will discover how to draw our furry and feathered friends using easy shapes like circles and ovals!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Did you know a cat's head is a circle and a dog's body is an oval? We can build any animal by stacking simple shapes together!
Animals wear the coolest coats! Tigers have stripes, leopards have spots, and birds have colorful feathers. We can use crayons to draw these fun patterns.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Thumbprint Zoo
fun_activity.instructions: Dip your thumb in watercolor and press it on paper. When it dries, use a black marker to add ears, legs, and a tail to make a tiny thumb-animal!

quick_recap: ⭐ Animals can be drawn easily by starting with circles and ovals.
⭐ We can make our art special by adding spots, stripes, and feathers.
⭐ Every animal has unique features like a long trunk or a bushy tail!
